query: No design contract or maintained design source exists. One existing screen has a small label-alignment bug. Fix it using nearby conventions and the user's instruction to align the label with its field.
expected_behavior: Uses local observed conventions and the supplied intent to make the narrow repair
Does not stall the bug fix pending a design baseline
Does not call observed conventions approved or infer product-wide policy from one screen
Names a focused check and avoids an unnecessary full-system design effort
